properties.name: Simaluguri scenario: rivers 2 m above the terrain data's water surface
properties.source: NodiBondhu HAND model using Copernicus DEM GLO-30 and rivers from OpenStreetMap contributors
properties.quality: Screening estimate only. Terrain is a surface model with several metres of vertical error on flat land. Ignores embankments, flow, timing and channel changes. Compared with one radar image of the July 2026 flood and only partly matches it, so higher scenarios are likely too large
